items.instruction:
A Winter Storm Warning for snow means severe winter weather
conditions will make travel very hazardous. If you must travel, keep
an extra flashlight, food and water in your vehicle in case of an
emergency.

For the latest road conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 29 at 5:36AM AKDT until October 30 at 5:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 30 to 45 mph with gusts up to 70 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 4 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds are likely late Thursday
night into Friday morning.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 29 at 5:31AM AKDT until October 31 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 2.5 to 3.5 feet above the normal high
tide expected during the Thursday and Friday high tides.

* WHERE...Hooper Bay.

* WHEN...From 7 AM Thursday to 1 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Beach property, the lowest buildings, & the access
road may be impacted. Multiple high tide cycles above normal
may lead to localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water levels of around 1 to 3 feet above
the normal high tide line are expected along the rest of the
Yukon Delta Coast
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
